core_obligations: Part (1): the proof observes that the vector x^-_theta t^{2k+1-i} applied to the highest weight vector has weight k theta, that x^+_alpha t^0 kills it, and concludes that the (kd_alpha+1)-st power of x^-_alpha t^0 kills it as well, by the standard sl_2 argument in the copy of sl_2 spanned by the three displayed elements (proof lines 469-476)

Part (2): substituting r = 2, s = 3k+1-i and alpha = theta in the commutation relation of the article gives a sum congruent to the desired product modulo the submodule generated by x^-_theta t^{2k+2-i} applied to the highest weight vector, with a labelled displayed equation inside the proof; acting on both sides by x^+_{theta-alpha} and using the annihilation relations gives the assertion (proof lines 477-491)
Part (3): the third relation is immediate from the second assertion of the lemma labelled g, whose statement is delivered as a context span (proof lines 492-493)
proof_roadmap: 第 (1) 部分：把 x^-_θ t^{2k+1-i} w̄ 视为权 kθ 的向量，用 x^+_α t^0 零化它，再用 ⟨x^+_α, x^-_α, α^∨⟩ 张成的 sl_2 的标准论证得 (x^-_α)^{kd_α+1} 零化它。
第 (2) 部分：在文章的交换关系里取 r = 2、s = 3k+1-i、α = θ 得一个同余式（证明中含带 label 的公式 (e)），再用 x^+_{θ-α} 作用并利用零化关系；(3) 由 lemma g 的第 (2) 条直接得到。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement records three relations that hold in the Demazure module D(1, (k+1)theta) attached to a multiple of the highest root: a power of a negative root vector annihilates a specific vector, a product of two such vectors lies in the submodule generated by a higher one, and a similar membership for two factors of the same root (author lemma at source lines 454-467, label crucial). The proof (source lines 468-493) proves the first relation by a standard sl_2 argument inside the copy of sl_2 spanned by the three displayed elements, obtains the second by specialising the article's labelled commutation relation and applying a raising operator to both sides, and derives the third from the second assertion of the lemma labelled g (proof lines 469-492). The sl_2 argument and the specialisation of the commutation relation are the content. H3.
